expected_behavior_change: Location expansion rejects time-segment candidates that contradict an explicit time-of-day in the selected environment, and the analyzer reports the shared location-domain reason code for any surviving night/day conflict.
expected_unchanged_behavior: Location prompts without an explicit time-of-day retain their existing candidate pool and deterministic selection; identity, clothing, mood, fallback, context-size, replay, workflow-output, and legacy JSON guards remain unchanged.
hypothesis: Filtering location time candidates against an explicit time-of-day already selected in the same location environment eliminates the deterministic night/midday conflict without changing unrelated location candidate selection.
rollback_condition: Reject the isolated candidate if the target conflict is not eliminated, analyzer precision misses the shared reason code, or any hard consistency, identity, fallback, context-size, determinism, public-contract, or qualitative-review guard fails.
